candidates.change_summary: Replace transfer with send, which returns false instead of reverting on failure, changing the behavior when the transfer fails.
Replace msg.sender==owner with true, removing the only-owner restriction.
Replace msg.sender==owner with false, making the function always revert.
Replace address(this).balance with 0, so the transfer always sends zero ether.
Replace address(this).balance with a constant amount, e.g. 1 ether, to send a fixed amount instead of the full balance.
Delete the transfer statement entirely, so the function does not send any ether but still requires the owner.
Delete the require statement, allowing anyone to call withdrawAll.
Replace _recipient with owner in the transfer call, sending the balance to the owner instead of the parameter address.
Replace _recipient with msg.sender in the transfer call, sending the balance to the caller instead of the parameter address.
Insert selfdestruct before the transfer, destroying the contract and sending the balance to _recipient via selfdestruct, which changes the post-call state.
